description: Rate-limits numeric input changes using a minimum value change threshold (deadband) and a time-based discard period (cooldown). Significant changes that arrive during cooldown are deferred and output when the cooldown expires.

inputs.name: Value
inputs.description: The raw numeric input value, e.g. from a sensor.

outputs.name: Value
outputs.description: The throttled output value. Updated only when the change exceeds the minimum threshold and the discard period has elapsed.

config.name: Minimum change
config.description: Minimum absolute difference from the last output value required to pass a new value through. Set to 0 to disable deadband filtering.

config.name: Discard period
config.description: Cooldown window in seconds after each output during which incoming values are suppressed. Set to 0 to disable time-based throttling.

state.name: Last output value
state.description: Tracks the last value sent to the output, used for deadband comparison.

state.name: Discarding
state.description: Whether the block is currently in the cooldown window.
